description: This file defines the 'Context' class which manages page interactions, action execution, request handling, and snapshot generation within a Playwright-based testing or automation framework.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Manages page actions, request monitoring, snapshotting, and token consumption within a browser context.

methods.name: runActionAndWait
methods.description: Executes a single action and waits for its completion.

methods.name: runActionsAndWait
methods.description: Executes multiple actions and waits for their completion, with optional no-wait behavior.

methods.name: runActionNoWait
methods.description: Executes a single action without waiting for its completion.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Returns a copy of the list of actions performed.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Returns the history of 'expect' or 'perform' items.

methods.name: pushHistory
methods.description: Adds a history item and clears current actions.

methods.name: consumeTokens
methods.description: Reduces the token budget by a specified amount.

methods.name: waitForCompletion
methods.description: Waits for page requests to complete, handling navigation and responses.

methods.name: snapshotResult
methods.description: Generates a snapshot of the page, redacting secrets, and returns a result object.
